query_normalized: predicting the impact of alloying on magnetic properties via public data materials science
rationale: The paper is a general survey on machine learning learning curves and decision-making frameworks, lacking any connection to the specific domain of materials science, alloying, or magnetic properties. It fails to satisfy any inclusion criteria (a-f) as it does not measure the relevant biological/physical mechanisms, variables, or populations, nor does it provide a foundational methodology specific to predicting material properties from public data.
